text:
deploy-bot: beginning staged rollout slice 4/8 for v2 traffic on api.redwood.com (deploy=rb-7171717171). watch window 20m. ops watchers: @marta @kevin. Auto-pin candidates will be evaluated before advancing.
marta: taking lead. quick context: previous rollouts showed streaming clients (older SDKs) hit a v2 stream reset bug. plan: pre-pin tenants where streaming_client=true and sdk_version < 3.5.0. we'll apply pins with 72h expiry.
kevin: spotted a pattern: 3 tenants in EU with high streaming pct. during a sim we saw stream resets ~0.6% and small 429 blips. not a hard failure, but enough to preempt. recommend pre-pin for t-770, t-881, t-992.
oli: can deploybot attach a reason tag and expiry? that helps later cleanup.
deploy-bot: yes. command: `deploybot pin-tenant --id <tenant> --route v1 --reason "streaming reset risk" --expires 2026-04-08T09:00:00Z`.
marta: applying pins now.
deploy-bot: pins applied: t-770 -> v1 (rb-7171717171-pinA), t-881 -> v1 (rb-7171717171-pinB), t-992 -> v1 (rb-7171717171-pinC).
kevin: re-run smoke: EU p50 latency +8ms, stream resets dropped to 0.05% in the pinned set. overall v2 error rate unchanged. good to continue.
jenny: adding rollback criteria to thread: immediate rollback if v2_error_rate >= 4% sustained for 5m OR stream_reset_rate > 0.5% for 3m OR v2_429_ratio >= 0.04 for 5m. latency circuit: p95 > 900ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> auto-fallback. Also set pager to infra@oncall for auto-fallback.
marta: documenting runbook change: add step to pre-pin streaming tenants during v2 rollouts. link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/v2-streaming.
kevin: brief release notes blurb: "During staged v2 rollout clients without explicit X-Api-Version may be routed to v1; streaming clients on older SDKs are temporarily pinned to v1 to avoid reset risk. Please upgrade SDK to 3.5.0+." I'll PR the docs.
oli: will notify SDK on-call and partners channel after slice completes.
deploy-bot: watch window active. next slice will be blocked for 25m post-pin for stability verification. will post status.
marta: keeping this thread as the single source of truth for pre-pin decisions and auto-fallback thresholds. updating if we unpin or rollback. :mag_right:
kevin: thumbs up. capturing traffic snapshots for post-deploy analysis if any alerts fire.
